scope: Fifteen retained Mech interpreted source programs; three fresh whole-process samples each. No other language or Mech mode is rerun.
checks: Exact fifteen retained source and executable identities
Canonical full input byte counts and SHA-256 identities
One stopwatch before Popen through blocking wait; no phase subtraction
Continuous shared mutex, inherited by every native process
Owned process cleanup and cancellation accounting
Complete output validation and all sample retention
Final prerequisite verification and exact raw artifact inventory
qualification_limit: Source review and tests do not constitute measured timings or publication admission.
